evaluation_process: persistent independent Isaac Lab process on the same GPU; training environment never reset by validation

rollback.restores: actor, critic, target critic, optimizer states, entropy temperature

rollback_followup.status: exploratory post-hoc follow-up after E100RB failures

variants.E0: No GT auxiliary; original robot-only critic
variants.E25: GT auxiliary until approximately 25k online steps
variants.E100: GT auxiliary until 100k online steps; Phase 3 E2 timing
variants.E100M: E100 with separate angle and contact prediction heads
variants.Q0: Shared robot-only encoder for policy and critic, no GT auxiliary
variants.QGT: Q0 with GT auxiliary until 100k, uniform replay
variants.QV: QGT with calibrated value-weighted trajectory replay
